DegradedAttribute.description: One specific way an entity loses fidelity. Vague entries are worse than none.

reason.description: Why the target cannot represent it faithfully.
reason.title: Reason

target_behaviour.description: What will actually happen on the target instead. This is the sentence the customer reads in the fidelity report, so write it for them.
target_behaviour.title: Target Behaviour

DegradedAttribute.title: DegradedAttribute

FidelityAssessment.description:
A fidelity claim, with the evidence required to make it.

The guardrail 'never mark an entity LOSSLESS by default' is enforced here
rather than left to connector authors' discipline.

assessed_by.description: Connector id or mapping-rule id that made this claim.
assessed_by.title: Assessed By

manual_effort_minutes.description: Estimated manual remediation effort. Required for UNMAPPABLE so the assessment report can total up the human cost of a migration.
manual_effort_minutes.title: Manual Effort Minutes

rationale.default: Not yet assessed: no fidelity rule has evaluated this entity.
rationale.title: Rationale

unmapped_source_attributes.description: Keys present in source_ref.native_attributes with no canonical home.
unmapped_source_attributes.title: Unmapped Source Attributes

FidelityAssessment.title: FidelityAssessment

FidelityLevel.description: How faithfully an entity survives the transform. See docs/fidelity-taxonomy.md.
FidelityLevel.title: FidelityLevel

Platform.description:
Platforms the canonical model can describe.

Adding a member here does not imply a working connector exists; the
connector's capability manifest is the authority on what is actually
supported.
Platform.title: Platform

PortOrderState.description: Port order lifecycle. Deliberately explicit: a stuck port is a stuck cutover.
PortOrderState.title: PortOrderState

SourceRef.description: Where this entity came from. Populated by ``Extract``, never by ``Apply``.

api_surface.description: Which API produced this, e.g. 'AXL:getPhone', 'Graph:/users', 'SAT:display station'. Needed to reproduce an extraction.
api_surface.title: Api Surface

instance_id.description: Cluster / tenant / workspace identifier. Distinguishes two CUCM clusters or two Teams tenants belonging to the same customer.
instance_id.title: Instance Id

native_attributes.description: Raw source attributes retained verbatim, including ones the canonical model does not map. Nothing is silently discarded; the assessment engine reports on the unmapped remainder.
native_attributes.title: Native Attributes

native_key.description: Vendor primary key: AXL pkid, Graph objectId, SMGR uid, Slack user id.
native_key.title: Native Key

native_type.description: Vendor's own name for the object type, e.g. 'Phone', 'CsOnlineUser', 'station'. Kept verbatim for audit.
native_type.title: Native Type

raw_sql_used.description: True if this object was read via an untyped escape hatch such as AXL executeSQLQuery. Surfaced in the audit log because raw SQL bypasses the vendor's own schema guarantees.
raw_sql_used.title: Raw Sql Used

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

TargetRef.description: Where this entity landed. Populated by ``Apply`` only.

correlation_id.description: Ties this write back to a run and an audit record.
correlation_id.title: Correlation Id

dry_run.description: True when the reference was produced by a dry run and therefore describes an object that does not exist on the target.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

TargetRef.title: TargetRef

TransformLogEntry.description: One recorded step in an entity's journey. Append-only; never rewritten.

actor.description: Connector id, rule id, or user principal that acted.
actor.title: Actor

rule_ref.description: Mapping-profile rule that caused this, if any.
rule_ref.title: Rule Ref

TransformLogEntry.title: TransformLogEntry

description: A number-porting order. Central to cloud -> on-prem repatriation (§3.7).

canonical_id.description: canonical_id of another entity in the same snapshot (a reference).
canonical_id.title: Canonical Id

checksum.description: Digest of extraction-scoped content. Set by seal(); verified on load.
checksum.title: Checksum

csr_fields.description: Customer Service Record data the carrier requires: billing telephone number, account number, service address, authorised signatory.
csr_fields.title: Csr Fields

display_name.description: Human label for grids and reports. Not an identifier.
display_name.title: Display Name

dual_homed_during_cutover.description: True while the number is live in both estates. Coexistence routing must account for this or calls fork.
dual_homed_during_cutover.title: Dual Homed During Cutover

loa_reference.description: Letter of Authority document id in object storage.
loa_reference.title: Loa Reference

items.description: canonical_id of another entity in the same snapshot (a reference).

numbers.description: Denormalised for the LOA packet and carrier CSR form.

items.description: Number in strict E.164 form, e.g. +442071838750.

numbers.title: Numbers

tags.description: Operator-assigned labels: wave, owner, exception id.
tags.title: Tags
